rows.comment: Plain legend text that says what a square means.
The caution is needed, but it is phrased as a rebuttal ("not a negative result") and uses a colon as a connector. State what a clear strip means and what the screen cannot distinguish.
rows.replacement: Ran on {ran} {ran, plural, one{day} other{days}}, raised its flag on {raised}. An outlined square marks a day it did not run. A clear strip does not rule anything out. The screen reads pulse timing and cannot tell an ectopic beat, a dropped beat or wrist movement apart.

rows.comment: "Away from sleep" is roundabout; "awake" says it directly.
rows.replacement: No awake resting breathing rate

rows.comment: Em dash, and the "not a day anything went wrong" rebuts a worry nobody raised. Give the cause directly.
lineComments: States the method, then the reason most days have no reading.
rows.replacement: This reads breathing only from three-minute stretches where the band saw you almost completely still, outside the sleep window. Most days have none because you were moving.

rows.comment: Opens with a "floor, not a rate" antithesis and uses an em dash. Say what the numbers are and what they omit.
lineComments: Keeps the limitation that breathing while moving cannot be read from beat timing.
rows.replacement: These are the stillest few minutes the band saw outside your sleep, the only stretches where breathing can be read. They say nothing about the rest of your day. Breathing while you move cannot be recovered from beat timing.

rows.comment: Gives the reason in few words.
States the state of the view.

"Several" and "a few" give no numbers. The minimum nights and observed hours live in the analytics sibling repo, not in edge (grep of lib/ finds no threshold for this view), so I cannot state them here. Reword without inventing figures; add the numbers once the analytics constants are read.
lineComments: Vague quantities with no backing in this repo.
rows.replacement: This view needs more nights, each with enough observed hours.

rows.comment: States a count and the reason. Plural block is correct.
States a count and the reason.
Long, with a stacked relative clause ("this screen counts has been running"). Say the comparison directly.
rows.replacement: Heart-rate cycling over your most recent nights is higher than across the {n} nights before them.

rows.comment: Same wordiness as the sibling string.
rows.replacement: Heart-rate cycling over your most recent nights is within the range of the {n} nights before them.

rows.comment: Medical caveat that must stay. It stacks "not X, not Y" and uses an em dash and "genuinely". Keep the limits, say them as plain facts.
lineComments: Keeps every listed cause and the beta-blocker, diabetes and nerve-condition caveat.
rows.replacement: This counts a pattern in your pulse. It does not measure breathing and is not a test for any condition. An irregular rhythm, altitude and any broken-up night produce the same cycling. Beta-blockers, diabetes and nerve conditions flatten it, so disturbed breathing can leave nothing here.

rows.comment: Stacked "nothing here" repetition, an em dash and the vague "a dozen reasons". Keep the safety meaning: a quiet result rules nothing out.
rows.replacement: A low or unchanged count does not rule anything out. It says nothing about any one night, because a single night's count varies on its own.

rows.comment: Safety advice with concrete symptoms and a clear action.

rows.replacement: Stage minutes

Status text for an empty result.
"The one with a coherence score" is a clipped fragment. Say what it is.
rows.replacement: Equal inhale and exhale at about {rate} breaths a minute. This is the pattern that gets a coherence score.

rows.comment: Accessibility label for a close button.
Short instruction on the session start screen.

rows.replacement: Follow the ring. Put the phone down.

rows.comment: Em dash. Split into two sentences.
rows.replacement: Needs the band on. The comparison uses beat timing.

rows.comment: "The pace your heart follows" is figurative. Name the feature.
rows.replacement: Find your resonance pace

rows.comment: "Before anything changes" is vague about what changes. Say Resonance changes its pace after two sittings agree.
lineComments: Keeps {rates} and the six-minute, two-minutes-each figures.
rows.replacement: Six minutes: {rates} breaths a minute, two minutes each. Resonance changes its pace only after two sittings pick the same rate.

rows.comment: Passive "is paced there". Name the actor.
rows.replacement: Two sittings agreed on {rate} breaths a minute, so Resonance now runs at that rate. Run it again to check.

rows.comment: "Not connected" fragment and "this one" are unclear. Say the band is not connected and the session is not saved.
rows.replacement: Scoring needs beat timing from the band. The band is not connected, so this session paces you but is not saved.

rows.comment: Stacked "nothing... nothing" negations. State what the app does.
rows.replacement: Breathe as you normally would. The app is not pacing or scoring this.

rows.comment: "The one paced at the rate the score is built for" is a clipped fragment. Say only Resonance is scored.
rows.replacement: {pattern} gets no coherence score. Only Resonance is paced at the rate the score is built for.

rows.comment: Filler line. Say the session is complete.
rows.replacement: Session complete.
Stopped early.

rows.comment: "And nothing else" is a punchy fragment and rebuts nothing that was claimed. The caveat about back-to-back blocks is useful and stays.
lineComments: Keeps the three-pace and back-to-back facts.
rows.replacement: This ranks three paces from one sitting. The blocks run back to back, so each pace is measured while you are still settling from the one before. It shows which pace your heart rate followed most strongly.

rows.comment: "Nothing has changed" is ambiguous. Say the pace is unchanged.
rows.replacement: You stopped partway, so there is nothing to compare. Your pace is unchanged.

rows.comment: Passive "could not be scored" and ambiguous "nothing has changed".
rows.replacement: At least one pace could not be scored, so there is nothing to rank. Your pace is unchanged.
